note: ETHGlobal's own events page, read anonymously. Only the cards whose stated type is "Async Hackathon" are taken: the IRL hackathons are real but happen in cities this board does not serve, and co-working days and conferences are not hackathons anywhere. The type pill is a stated field, so neither the hackathon question nor the online question is inferred from a title.
